ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed NirCmd.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "NirCmd.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields.

sequences.query: process_original_file_name = "NirCmd\.exe" AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\nircmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nircmdc\\\.exe$")))
